مُفَوَّقٌ (tropical:) Food, and beverage, that is taken by little and little. (IAar, O, K, TA. [See its verb.]) ＝
-A2- Applied to an arrow, [Having a notch made for the bow-string. (See 2.) ―
-b2- And] Having the bow-string put into its notch on the occasion of shooting: [see 4, last sentence:] ―
-b3- whence the saying, لَا زِلْتَ الخَيْرِ مُوَفَّقًا وَسَهْمُكَ فِى الكَرَمِ مُفَوَّقًا (assumed tropical:) [Mayest thou not cease to be rightly disposed in beneficence, and thine arrow made ready with the bow-string put into its notch in generosity]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
